verdict.rationale: Khoj is a personal AI assistant, so reaching out to paired devices is a fair axis. However, the evidence shows only multi-client access (Emacs, Obsidian, desktop app, web, WhatsApp), email automations, and text-to-speech of its own messages. Nothing shows Khoj pairing with phones or computers to capture screenshots, use cameras, push device notifications, or control media playback, and those adjacent features earn no credit.
